assets.purpose: Continuous physical paper-to-yacht transformation, reused for opening and payoff
acceptanceCriteria: Opening is recognisably a folded paper boat
Same hull and sail visibly change continuously
Material and scale changes remain coherent with camera and water
Final yacht remains above believable moving water
No disc edge, missing horizon, popping parts or broken silhouettes
Opening stays dark and intentional
Original geometry/proportions are maintained
Layer/material reveal and lighting have visible depth
Camera settles at 3.2 seconds and logo holds clearly
Sound rise and impact resolve at lockup
